Plugin.Name: Fejes Mover Monitor
Plugin.Overview: Stable build 2026.11.11.2 for the documented Unraid 7.x scope. Hungarian, US English and German Mover dashboard and open-file monitor. Observer mode is the default. Advanced mode provides opt-in age-filtered native movement with torrent protection and SHA-256 verification. Selective movement is limited to the documented reviewed local setup; other configurations should use Observer mode. Installation does not create a schedule or start movement. In an isolated Unraid 7 VM, a 16 MiB torrent passed the full guarded move, recheck and peer transfer with matching SHA-256. After reboot, missing scrub history may require a fresh scrub before movement. Public tracker credit, power-loss recovery, broad compatibility and Unraid 8 are not verified. Details: https://github.com/fejesgabortorrent-dot/unraid-fejes-mover-monitor/blob/main/docs/ACCEPTANCE-20261112.md
